How much does a website really cost? (The honest answer)

Pages and features. A five-page business site is a very different project from a 500-product store with subscriptions. The more pages, templates and custom features you need, the more design and development time it takes.

Platform and integrations. WordPress usually means lower running costs and more flexibility, while Shopify bundles hosting and checkout into a monthly plan. CRM, booking or inventory integrations add development time on either platform.

Content, SEO and migration. Need help writing copy, moving thousands of products or protecting your existing Google rankings? We plan for it up front, so there are no surprise invoices halfway through your project.
